structured_output.what_is_happening: This is a pump.fun coin called "PsyopAnime". It is 95 minutes old, migrated to PumpSwap, and sits at about $32k market cap with $15k of locked LP. Its description says fees go to the @PsyopAnime X account via UsePaid, so it looks like a fee-share launch that uses an existing account's name. The creator wallet shows 18,793 launched tokens, which marks a mass launcher. A well-established PsyopAnime token already exists at about $614k market cap, launched in January 2026, plus several dead same-name clones from today. This coin has done about $278k volume in 6 hours. It is down about 65% from its ATH, and it just triggered on a sharp +125% 5-minute bounce with 29 buys against 10 sells.

narrative.description: This is a derivative or clone play on the PsyopAnime brand. The coin exists to send fees to an existing X account. The narrative is not new: a canonical token with the same name already trades much higher.
narrative.why_spreading: The first-hour volume looks like launch churn from bots, bundles and snipers, not a spreading story. The current bounce is a dead-cat pattern after a 65% drawdown from the ATH.

token_connection.why_this_token: This is the only same-day PsyopAnime clone that migrated and has real liquidity. The fee-share link to the @PsyopAnime account gives it a thin tie to the brand.
token_connection.competing_tokens: The canonical PsyopAnime token (2nP9...pump) is at $614k market cap with $172k liquidity and was launched in January 2026. There are also at least 5 dead same-name clones from today.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN counts 495 bundler wallets, 427 fresh wallets and 33 snipers. The bot/degen rate is 57%, top-70 snipers hold 32%, and the dev team holds 17.7%. The creator has 18,793 launches. The project X account was renamed from ufoxmovie, so it is recycled. The image is duplicated.
authenticity.uncertainty: There are 42 smart and 3 renowned wallets among traders, and 1,095 unique buyers in 6 hours. Some real participation exists, but I can't see X activity.

structural_risks: The dev and team hold 17.7% and snipers hold 32%, which is heavy dump overhang
The creator is a mass launcher with 18k tokens
The canonical same-name token absorbs brand demand
The coin is already down 65% from its ATH, and each bounce meets sellers who bought higher
Entry 4 minutes after a +125% 5-minute spike risks buying the top of the spike

structured_output.counterargument: The mint and freeze authorities are renounced, the LP is burned, and RugCheck's risk score is 1. Buyers are outpacing sellers in the last 5–15 minutes, and a 2x from here (about $65k market cap) is still below the earlier ATH (about $92k). A reclaim of the earlier range on a fee-share hype wave could plausibly hit the take-profit, and 42 smart wallets suggest active traders are watching.

structured_output.thesis: This is a mass-launcher clone of an established ticker, already 65% down from its ATH, with heavy bundler and sniper presence. The trigger is a sharp bounce that an entry 4 minutes later is likely to catch near the local top. Structurally it is safe from a hard LP pull because the LP is burned, but a slow bleed to -50% is more likely than a 2x.
